description: The Capacity Enhancement Project of the Departure Passenger Terminal at the Bandaranaike International Airport, Katunayake
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-07-13 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025-02-09 to implement the procurement process for the construction of a new building for thirty six (36) check-in counters and six (06) new Satellite boarding Gates from the passenger terminal under the Infrastructure Development Project for Departing Passenger Capacity Enhancement at the Bandaranaike International Airport, Katunayake. Bids have been invited to select a suitable contractor for the purpose by following the International Competitive Procurement Procedure and three (03) bids have been received for the same. The proposal made by the Minister of Ports and Civil Aviation to award the said contract to M/s Maga Engineering (Pvt) Ltd., the substantially responsive lowest bidder, based on the recommendation submitted by the Standing High Level Procurement Committee after evaluation of the said bids, was approved by the Cabinet.
